renderer.fontPolicy: Test-only font-family override to the app self-hosted JetBrains Mono for every text element and pseudo element. CDP must confirm every rendered glyph uses this custom font. System fallbacks fail.
renderer.imageVersionPolicy: Capture records ImageVersion. Tick-approved Linux pins must set this exact value before comparison; a later hosted image requires a new review.

comparison.justification: No pixel tolerance: the same hosted image, bundled browser, scale, emulation and self-hosted glyphs must render identically. No layout or colour change is permitted; no anti-aliasing allowance is currently needed.

capture.writes: Only Playwright testInfo.outputPath() captures and the run artifact under web/test-results; never reference paths, tickets, releases or Git.
